senses.gloss: ch. (preced.) to draw, spread, strike (butter, salve &c.).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 38:21">Targ. Is. XXXVIII, 21</cite> <he>ויִשְׁטְרוּן</he> ed. Vien. (ed. Lag. <he>וישיטרון</he>; ed. Wil. <he>וישורטון</he>), v. <cite ref="U00742"><he>שְׁטַח</he></cite>.—
Gitt. 69ᵇ ונִשְׁטְרִינְהוּ בכמכא and let him strike kamakh (v. כָּמַךְ) over it; (Rashi: let him soak it in k.).
<cite ref="Gittin 69b:4">Ib.</cite> <he>ונשטרינהו בדובשא</he> and strike honey over it.
<cite ref="Pesachim 44a:9">Pes. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>אי מִשְׁטַר קָשְׁטַר וכ׳</he> if he spreads it (on bread) and eats it (Rashi: if he dips bread into it); <cite ref="Nazir 36b:3">Naz. 36ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 85b:14">B. Mets. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>אִשְׁטַר לך משטר</he> I will smear thee a salve (over thy eyes).
